The 5 `suppressed` (DEDUP-002/003/005/007/012) are excluded per authoritative prior triage and are NOT re-classified here. pocsRequired.note: Only DEDUP-001 carries a Medium (the only H/M in the set), so exactly one PoC is required — and it is the contingency PoC that decides whether DEDUP-001 survives as Medium or collapses to informational/invalid.

classifiedFindings.title: Realizable-solvency value leak: surplus / solvency / totalBalanceOf priced at the VAULT rate but value is only realizable at the AMM rate; skim strips the discount buffer, socializing a principal shortfall onto last-out stakers

classification.assetImpact: Last-out staker realizes less than credited principal: skimSurplus harvests the deposit-time slippage-haircut buffer at the VAULT rate (convertToAssets), removing the over-collateralization (held*p - D) that was absorbing the AMM discount; under a sustained sUSDe AMM discount (r = P_amm/P_vault < 1) the shares remaining to back principal are worth less than principal at the only realizable rate. Tier-3 counterexamples log a 28.5e18 staker shortfall and a 48.5e18 last-out swing for a 3% discount.
attackPath: 1. Client deposits ~1e18 -> credited principal 0.95e18, held 1e18 shares (0.05e18 buffer).
2. Owner/keeper calls skimSurplus -> strips the 0.05e18 buffer shares at the vault rate; held now == principal-worth at vault rate.
3. sUSDe trades below NAV on the Curve AMM (natural sustained depeg, NOT atomic manipulation).
4. Last-out staker exits (totalWithdrawal / proportional exit) and realizes held*q < totalDeposited -> socialized shortfall.
classification.likelihood: Conditional on an EXTERNAL precondition: sUSDe trading below NAV on the realizable venue, sustained (not closed within blocks by arbitrage). sUSDe has historically discounted several percent in stress, so the precondition is realistic in principle — BUT the magnitude/realizability that lifts this above M-02's accepted bound is UNVERIFIED pending PoC (see contingency).
classification.assumptions: Skim is run while a buffer exists; a sustained natural sUSDe/USDe AMM discount materializes after the skim; the discount is realized by a last-out exit rather than recovered before exit.
classification.externalRequirements: Sustained sUSDe NAV/AMM decoupling on the Curve route. This is the same vault-rate-vs-AMM-rate root cause as acknowledged ledger M-02 (NAV-anchored minOut, accepted residual bounded at slippageBps x tradeSize). DEDUP-001's distinct claim is that the skim-de-buffering mechanism BREAKS that bound.

classifiedFindings.justification: Classified MEDIUM and the High escalation is explicitly withheld (HONORED SANITIZER CAP). C4: value leak with a hypothetical attack path, stated assumptions, and an external requirement (sustained sUSDe AMM discount) -> Medium ceiling, not direct asset theft. THE CRUX / CONTINGENCY (must be preserved): run-11 audited the SAME commit 2306719 and authoritatively REJECTED the closely-related ECON-004 / M-02-run11 vault-oracle finding as a false-positive because its PoC relied on a hard-coded mock AMM decoupled from the vault price that real arbitrage / the Curve NG rate oracle would close; the residual NAV-anchored leak is the ACKNOWLEDGED M-02 bounded by slippageBps x tradeSize. DEDUP-001's claim to EXCEED that bound rests on a STILL-FAILING Tier-3 invariant (forge invariant_realizableSolvency + medusa property_realizableSolvency) whose realism is UNVERIFIED: its harness drives the AMM discount via an independently-settable MockAMMAdapter sell rate (setSellRate), i.e. exactly the hard-coded decoupling modeling concern run-11 flagged. SEVERITY IS THEREFORE CONTINGENT ON THE PoC: if the PoC demonstrates a REALISTIC, sustained, non-hard-coded sUSDe AMM discount that the NG rate oracle / arbitrage does not close, the skim-de-buffering shortfall is a genuine Medium the bounded M-02 acknowledgement does not cover; if the PoC can only reproduce the failure via a hard-coded mock discount, the finding COLLAPSES toward the already-rejected M-02-run11 false-positive (informational / invalid) and the bounded M-02 acknowledgement stands. NOT a regression of fixed M-01 (different rootCauseClass: M-01 was duplicate-client over-skim, structurally removed by story-041; DEDUP-001 attacks the RATE at which the ceiling/solvency claim is denominated). This borderline is flagged PROMINENTLY for human review.

pocRealismContingency.ifRealisticNaturalDiscount: medium (genuine value leak beyond M-02's slippageBps x tradeSize bound)
pocRealismContingency.ifHardcodedMockOnly: informational / invalid (collapses to rejected M-02-run11 / ECON-004; bounded M-02 acknowledgement governs)
pocRealismContingency.harnessConcern: Tier-3 harness sets the AMM realizable rate q via MockAMMAdapter.setSellRate INDEPENDENTLY of the vault convertToAssets rate p — the PoC must show the discount is a NATURAL sustained sUSDe depeg, not a mock decoupling arbitrage/the NG rate oracle would close within blocks.

classifiedFindings.title: slippageToleranceBps overloaded as principal-credit haircut with no sane upper bound (non-obvious owner footgun)

classification.assetImpact: No direct theft. Raising slippageToleranceBps to absorb a wider AMM spread silently haircuts every subsequent deposit's credited principal by the same proportion (creditedPrincipal = amount*(MAX_BPS-bps)/MAX_BPS). Bounded only by the still-missing upper cap.
classification.likelihood: Owner action with a non-obvious consequence (Law-3 footgun); not attacker-driven.
classification.assumptions: Owner raises tolerance for a legitimate operational reason without realizing it also haircuts principal credit.

classifiedFindings.justification: Confirms inherited ledger severity LOW (L-01, open since run-05; run-11 ruled net Low). C4 Low/QA: missing input validation + non-obvious owner footgun (operational hazard, Law-3 in-scope) — the principal-haircut coupling at MODERATE plausible tolerance (e.g. 2000 bps) is the in-scope non-obvious sub-case. The MAX_BPS extreme (credited principal -> 0, minOut -> 0) is an OBVIOUS misconfig and belongs to the centralization/owner-power envelope (C-01), not a standalone finding. No new evidence escalates the open Low. Carryover stub for L-01 (shared with DEDUP-006).
classifiedFindings.safeConfigGuidance: Decouple the swap slippage floor from the principal-credit haircut, OR add a conservative upper bound to setSlippageTolerance and document that the parameter haircuts credited principal.

classifiedFindings.title: slippageToleranceBps default 0 deposit/withdraw DoS — strictest floor at construction until owner sets non-zero (fails-closed deploy footgun)

classification.assetImpact: No fund loss. At the constructed default bps=0, deposit/withdraw minOut demands the full vault-rate fair value, which a real Curve swap essentially never returns, so all flows revert until setSlippageTolerance(bps>0). Fails closed.
classification.likelihood: Deploy-ordering footgun; the inverted semantics (0 reads as 'lenient' but encodes the strictest floor) is the non-obvious part.
classification.assumptions: Owner deploys and exposes the strategy before setting a non-zero tolerance.

classifiedFindings.justification: Confirms inherited ledger severity LOW (same L-01 entry; run-11 explicitly: 'zero-default sub-case ... a real but minor deploy-ordering footgun ... net Low'). Availability-only and fails-closed (no fund loss, owner self-cures with one setter call), so it does not reach the Medium availability bar — a deploy-time config-ordering hazard, not an attacker-induced or persistent availability loss. Maps to the SAME ledger entry L-01 as DEDUP-004 (one carryover stub covers both).
classifiedFindings.safeConfigGuidance: Require a non-zero slippageToleranceBps at construction, or set a sane non-zero default.

classifiedFindings.title: CurveAMMAdapter.setRoute endpoint-only validation — swapParams coin indices, pools array, and reverse-route inverse-consistency unvalidated on-chain

classification.assetImpact: No on-chain theft under the trusted-router assumption. A wrong coin index/pool or non-inverse reverse route passes endpoint-only validation; blast radius bounded because Curve Router NG reverts a genuinely invalid route and minOut floors every swap, so a bad route DoS's the swap rather than mis-delivering value silently.
classification.likelihood: Owner deploy-time configuration footgun; relies on off-chain AMMRoutes.json correctness.
classification.assumptions: Owner sets a malformed route that still passes endpoint checks.

classifiedFindings.justification: Confirms inherited ledger severity LOW (L-07, open since run-07). Incomplete on-chain route validation = state/validation Low + owner footgun. The Slither uninitialized-local 'lastToken' (STATIC-008) sub-flag is DISMISSED here as a false positive (CODE-004 refutation: the loop always runs and path[0]==tokenIn is required non-zero, so lastToken is always assigned before the require). NOTE FOR FINDING-MANAGER: ledger L-10 (run-11) currently carries that same lastToken flag as OPEN — surface the L-10 status for reconciliation; this classifier agrees with the FP dismissal.
classifiedFindings.reconciliationNote: Ledger L-10 (lastToken uninitialized-local) should be reconciled — dismissed FP here.
classifiedFindings.safeConfigGuidance: Treat AMMRoutes.json correctness and reverse-inverse consistency as a deploy-time review gate; document that on-chain validation is endpoint-only.

classifiedFindings.title: CEI violation in deposit/withdraw — state written after external swap/transfer; REFUTED as exploitable under the non-hooked-ERC20 trust model, retained as documented latent assumption

classification.assetImpact: None under the current trust model. State updates after external calls, but all state-mutating entry points share OZ nonReentrant and the only external calls in the stale window are to the trusted Curve adapter and to plain ERC20 transfer/transferFrom of non-hooked tokens — no attacker callback, so read-only reentrancy against the unguarded views is unreachable.
classification.likelihood: Latent only — becomes live solely if a transfer-hook/FoT/ERC777 token is ever wired in (out of the current registry trust model).
classification.assumptions: Non-hooked ERC20 underlying + vault share token; nonReentrant preserved on all callers.
classification.externalRequirements: Would require a hooked/FoT token to be wired in to activate.

classifiedFindings.justification: Confirms inherited ledger severity LOW (L-01-run11, open since run-11). Informational/latent: CEI-after-interaction with nonReentrant + non-hooked-ERC20 fully neutralizing exploitability. The six consolidated Slither/Aderyn reentrancy flags (STATIC-006/007/012/013/014) are the Tier-1 precursors of the same pattern. Retained per Law-1 recall as a documented latent assumption; no escalation.

classifiedFindings.function: totalWithdrawal, skimSurplus, deposit, withdraw, depositAsOwner, withdrawAsOwner (lines 319,366,229,248,265,279)

classifiedFindings.justification: Confirms inherited ledger severity LOW (L-04-run11, open since run-11). Defense-in-depth/style note across the same 6-function instance set; genuinely Low/QA. No escalation.

classifiedFindings.title: _totalWithdraw state-inconsistency: migration recorded as executed even when sharesToSell floors to 0 for a tiny-balance client (principal left on books, nothing moved)

classification.assetImpact: No fund loss — the un-migrated client retains full principal. _totalWithdraw only zeroes clientBalances and decrements totalDeposited inside `if (sharesToSell > 0)`; for a client whose live balance is a tiny fraction of totalDeposited, sharesToSell can floor to 0, so the function moves nothing yet the two-phase state machine is reset and WithdrawalExecuted is emitted. Hazard is operational (owner may believe a migration completed when it did not).
classification.likelihood: Benign edge condition; tiny-balance client + sharesToSell rounding to zero.
classification.assumptions: A client balance small enough that vault-share conversion floors to 0.

classifiedFindings.justification: NEW. C4 QA/Low: state-handling / incorrect-as-to-operational-intent, no asset impact. Distinct from H-02 (false-positive, run-11) — the cached-vs-live-read facet overlaps H-02's adjudication ('reading live balance is arguably more correct for a migration') and is NOT re-raised here; the PRIMARY false-migration-complete root cause is benign and novel. The cached-vs-live facet was routed by the faithfulness scanner as a documented quirk (no story-036 criterion pins to the snapshot), so this is NOT a faithfulness F — plain state-handling Low.
classifiedFindings.recommendation: Either revert / flag when sharesToSell floors to 0 with non-zero principal, or document that a sub-threshold balance is a no-op migration.

classifiedFindings.title: story-043 'provable solvency invariant' overstated: ERC4626 double round-down means convertToAssets(convertToShares(creditedPrincipal)) can be a few wei below creditedPrincipal
classifiedFindings.specSource: story-043 (commit a65dbf0 body) + _creditedPrincipal NatSpec lines 207-210: 'fairValueOfShares >= creditedPrincipal a provable solvency invariant'

classification.assetImpact: Sub-wei / few-wei rounding dust per deposit (accumulates on flat markets); no realizable asset impact. The conservative-crediting INTENT is faithfully implemented.
classification.assumptions: ERC4626 convertToShares and convertToAssets both round down.

classifiedFindings.justification: FAITHFULNESS (Law-2) — routed to the spec-conformance report as F-01, NOT the QA/gas bundle. story-043 claims the solvency invariant is 'provable'; strictly the round-trip can dip below creditedPrincipal by ERC4626 double-round-down dust, so the 'provable' qualifier is overstated. Pure behavioural/claim deviation with negligible security impact, but surfaced visibly to the owner per Law-2 rather than dropped into noise. Conservative crediting itself conforms.
classifiedFindings.recommendation: Amend the claim to 'fairValue >= creditedPrincipal - dust', or add a small protocol-favoring epsilon to minOut so the round-trip cannot dip below creditedPrincipal.

classifiedFindings.title: block.timestamp drives the two-phase withdrawal window (24h waiting / 48h execution) — load-bearing and intended; miner drift negligible

classification.assetImpact: None. The 24h/48h windows far exceed any plausible miner timestamp drift (~12s), so the window cannot be straddled.
classification.likelihood: Not exploitable; timestamp logic is intended and load-bearing.
classification.assumptions: Block timestamps within normal validator drift.

classifiedFindings.justification: NEW informational/QA. Kept VISIBLE per the static stage's explicit Law-1 policy for a time-driven protocol; drift is negligible against a 24h/48h window. No security impact.

classification.assumptions: Tokens accidentally sent to the adapter, or router leaves dust.
